# Commands

Every command of SupMod 2.3, with the permission checked by the plugin.

- `<argument>`: required, `[argument]`: optional, `a|b`: one of them.
- `/supmod` can also be written `/sm`. Every staff command has tab completion.
- Durations: `30s`, `10m`, `2h`, `7d`, `2w`, `1mo`, `1y`, combinable (`1d12h`), or `perm`.
- `-s` at the end of a punishment: silent punishment (only the staff is told).

## Commands for every player {#players}

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/report [player]` | `supmod.report` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Report a player: choose a reason in a menu, then add a comment. |
| `/ticket <message>` | `supmod.ticket` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Ask the staff for help (creates a ticket). |
| `/helpop <message>` | `supmod.ticket` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Same as /ticket: the question goes to the staff. |
| `/ticket reply [id] <message>` | `supmod.ticket` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Add a message to your open ticket. |
| `/ticket view [id]` | `supmod.ticket` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | See your ticket and the answers of the staff. |
| `/ticket close [id]` | `supmod.ticket` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Close your ticket. |
| `/ticket rate <id> <1-5>` | `supmod.ticket` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Rate the help (the stars are also clickable in the chat). |
| `/appeal <message>` | `supmod.appeal` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Appeal your current mute (or warning if allowed). |
| `/appeal <code> <message>` | `supmod.appeal` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Appeal a ban with the code shown on the ban screen. |
| `/afk` | `supmod.afk` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Away from keyboard (on / off). |
| `/rewards` | `supmod.rewards` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Play time rewards and daily reward. |
| `/daily` | `supmod.rewards` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Claim the daily reward. |
| `/playtime` | `supmod.playtime` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Your play time. |
| `/playtime <player> \| top` | `supmod.playtime.others` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Play time of a player, or the top players. |
| `/stats [player]` | `supmod.stats` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Statistics (another player needs supmod.stats.others). |
| `/stats top [board]` | `supmod.stats` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Leaderboards: playtime, kills, coins, streak. |
| `/bounty <player> <amount>` | `supmod.bounty` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Put a price on the head of a player. |
| `/bounty list` | `supmod.bounty.list` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Current bounties. |
| `/coins` | `supmod.coins` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Your balance. |
| `/coins balance <player>` | `supmod.coins.player` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Balance of a player. |
| `/coins pay <player> <amount>` | `supmod.coins.pay` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Pay a player. |
| `/coins top` | `supmod.coins.top` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Richest players. |
| `/coins history` | `supmod.coins.history` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Your transactions. |
| `/sidebar` | `supmod.sidebar.toggle` <span class="who everyone">Everyone</span> | Show or hide the sidebar. |

## Punishments {#punishments}

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/warn <player> [reason] [-s]` | `supmod.punish.warn` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Warn a player (shown at his next join if offline). |
| `/mute <player> [duration] [reason] [-s]` | `supmod.punish.mute` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Mute temporarily (30m, 2h, 7d...) or permanently. |
| `/unmute <player> [reason]` | `supmod.punish.unmute` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Lift a mute. |
| `/kick <player> [reason] [-s]` | `supmod.punish.kick` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Kick a player. |
| `/ban <player> [duration] [reason] [-s]` | `supmod.punish.ban` <span class="who admin">Admin</span> | Ban temporarily or permanently (works for offline players). |
| `/ipban <player> [duration] [reason] [-s]` | `supmod.punish.ipban` <span class="who admin">Admin</span> | Ban the player and his IP address. |
| `/unban <player> [reason]` | `supmod.punish.unban` <span class="who admin">Admin</span> | Lift a ban. |
| `/punish <player> [template] [-s]` | `supmod.punish.menu` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Punishment menu, or apply the next step of a template. |
| `/history <player>` | `supmod.punish.history` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Punishment history (revoke from the menu). |

## Staff tools {#staff}

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/staffmode` | `supmod.staffmode` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Staff mode: inventory saved, vanish, fly and the tools in the hotbar. |
| `/vanish [player]` | `supmod.vanish` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Become invisible (another player: supmod.vanish.others). |
| `/freeze <player>` | `supmod.freeze` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Freeze or unfreeze a player. |
| `/staffchat [message]` | `supmod.staffchat` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Staff chat: send a message, or toggle it without message. Prefix # works too. |
| `/commandspy` | `supmod.commandspy` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | See the commands typed by the players. |
| `/gm [0-3\|mode] [player]` | `supmod.gamemode` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Change the game mode; without argument, opens the menu. Each mode needs supmod.gamemode.&lt;mode&gt;. |
| `/gmc /gms /gma /gmsp [player]` | `supmod.gamemode` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Creative, survival, adventure, spectator. Another player: supmod.gamemode.others. |
| `/ticket list` | `supmod.ticket.manage` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Queue of the tickets (menu). |
| `/ticket claim <id>` | `supmod.ticket.manage` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Take a ticket in charge. |
| `/ticket answer <id> <message>` | `supmod.ticket.manage` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Answer a ticket. |
| `/ticket done <id>` | `supmod.ticket.manage` <span class="who staff">Staff</span> | Close a ticket (the player is asked to rate). |
| `/broadcast <message>` | `supmod.broadcast` <span class="who admin">Admin</span> | Message to the whole server. |

:::
